question: After fixing admission concurrency, should OpenClaw adopt global fail-closed handling for unattributed calls and the proposed public plugin/provider budget-accounting APIs?
rationale: The concurrency defect has a mechanical repair, but unsupported-runtime denial, SDK exposure, configuration shape, and upgrade policy are durable product and compatibility decisions.

options.title: Adopt after narrowing
options.body: Fix short-lived reservation locking, then narrow and approve the permanent attribution, fail-closed, configuration, SDK, and migration contracts.

options.title: Start with model calls
options.body: Ship only the canonical model-call boundary first and defer unsupported media, speech, voice, node, and plugin-runtime policy.

options.title: Decline core enforcement
options.body: Keep provider-level or external spend controls rather than accepting a broad core budget contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt after narrowing
recommendation.body: Fix short-lived reservation locking, then narrow and approve the permanent attribution, fail-closed, configuration, SDK, and migration contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged history and protected maintainer signal connect this owner to the central runtime and product decision surfaces.
